G1_unambiguity.justification: The definitions of the active set, the three validity conditions, the input, and the required output leave essentially no reasonable ambiguity.

G2_completeness.justification: All constraints, input formats, cost ranges, feasibility guarantees, objective details, and relevant edge cases such as an empty selection are specified.

G3_faithfulness.justification: With positive edge costs, an optimal connected solution can be reduced to a spanning tree in which every optional vertex has degree at least two, making the algebraic validity conditions equivalent to the original connectivity requirement and preserving the minimum cost.

G4_naturalness.justification: The statement is coherent and readable, though its algebraic reformulation is more elaborate and somewhat less natural than the original cabling formulation.
